scope: One small sequential native linux/arm64 viability experiment on official Node14.21.3 and16.20.2 bullseye-slim, using genuine official pnpm10.34.7 executable; no C compile/common-base qualification.
identity_checks_before_any_run: Use exact arm64 child digests, not mutable tags/index platform inference. Registry index, child and config bytes have already been SHA256+size verified and retained. NODE_VERSION currently is config metadata only.

After a permitted pull, require actual Docker image configID equal the frozen registry config digest and linux/arm64. Actual node --version/npm --version are experimental observations, not asserted from ENV.

pnpm npm tarball must match exact frozen npm SHA512 SRI and SHA1 shasum; additionally compare extracted executable to official GitHub v10.34.7 raw binary SHA256c57bafc919110f5b942b7778bff0f2170a896d6dc0952c2ff042ca1e228655c3 and size63488279. These are currently metadata pins, NOT body-qualified.
Registry tarball SHA256 is unknown until the authorized complete body read. Record that observed SHA256 after SRI/SHA1 pass; never invent it. Preserve original tarball and license.

MIT license metadata and tagged1170B LICENSE (SHA2564b8e2a57502758b2d034ece9cabf19dd098c5609003ed8dbdafd085274f25bd9) retained; retain every license file from the actual tar package and compare provenance.

budget.fixed_breakdown: Tarball hard bound32MiB (HEAD had no Content-Length); extracted package declared63490247B, reserve64MiB; metadata/fixtures/receipts/logs reserve16MiB; remaining16MiB buffer. Existing prior research is preserved and no executable body has been downloaded.
budget.image_size_limit: Registry descriptors establish compressed totals68684172B/68339448B only. Uncompressed storage is UNKNOWN, so no honest claim of a proven512MiB fit can be made from those descriptors alone.
budget.size_preflight_after_root_approval: Before pulling each image, permit one stream/discard read of that exact slim image layers to verify compressed digest/size and measure decompressed tar bytes + file allocation estimate, with bounded buffers/no persisted layers. Reuse existing canonical streaming/hash concepts, not a new artifact framework. Proceed to Docker only if compressed+estimated installed allocation+metadata margin fits384MiB daemon reservation. Any body error or unsuitable fit stops before pull; no retry/second image by assumption.
budget.external_guard: One-second physical-free and own scratch/daemon-delta samples. Stop only own active client/container at>=448MiB attributed growth or <=floor+64MiB, retaining64MiB stop margin; no claim this observer is a kernel disk quota. If foreign activity makes attribution or headroom unclear, stop this experiment, retain evidence, no foreign cleanup.
budget.sequential: One image and one container at a time. Retire only safe newly introduced references after case1; fresh capacity/preconditions before case2. If references cannot safely be removed, do not start case2.

read_only_preflight_after_approval: Check native host/Docker daemon architecture is linux/arm64; capture docker version/info relevant storage mode and docker image/container metadata only, no global builder/use/config mutation.
Unique absent /private/tmp/bex-w8-pnpm-smoke-<nonce>; record all source/fixture input hashes. One owner label and nonce assigned at docker create before an ID is returned.
Snapshot exact existing image references, configIDs and containers using either frozen configID before pull. No assumption that images remain absent since the earlier root inventory.
Fresh physical free must cover full512MiB budget +2GiB floor +128MiB proactive margin. No image/buildpack pull, artifact body read or Docker mutation until root approves this plan and it fits.

container_contract.ownership: Unique exact name + owner/nonce/case labels at create. Resolve ownID from labels/name/configID after interrupted create; never select by PID or broad name search.
container_contract.mounts: Verified executable directory read-only at /opt/pnpm (no node beside it); new fixture input read-only; only own work/output mount writable. /tmp tmpfs16MiB. Per-container HOME/PNPM_HOME/XDG cache below own workdir, no host/global HOME or caches/config changes.
container_contract.PATH: Record original image PATH; add only /opt/pnpm for command discovery, containing no Node binary. Never inject privateNode24 or replace app Node/npm.
container_contract.bounds: Per-command30s normally; explicit different-PM offline observation15s; whole case<=180s. Bounded stdout/stderr<=1MiB per command, total retained outputs<=16MiB. No curl/apt/npm install/network inside runtime.

project_observations.name: startup
project_observations.operation: Unmodified genuine pnpm --version, app node --version/npm --version, command -v and realpath of node/pnpm; capture actual exit and output.

project_observations.name: unmodified_lifecycle
project_observations.operation: With NODE initially absent, use a local dependency tarball with narrowly allowed install lifecycle plus a root run script. Record process.version/execPath, PATH resolution, NODE/npm_node_execpath/npm_execpath/configured node-gyp. Do not silently normalize observed defaults.

project_observations.name: engine_selection
project_observations.operation: Separate matching engines14.x/16.x and deliberate>=18 dependency/root cases with project-local engine-strict=true. Offline local-only install must accept the matching app and reject the mismatch. Never use a private host version to bypass this.

project_observations.name: exec_and_path
project_observations.operation: Actual pnpm exec node and pnpm run node observer, plus scripts-prepend-node-path=true, must identify selected app Node despite legitimate node_modules/.bin additions.

project_observations.name: transparent_NODE_comparison
project_observations.operation: After preserving unmodified observations, a separately labeled planned command may set NODE to the already observed PATH appNode (no launcher/shim/source patch), then repeat lifecycle observer. Preserve an explicit NODE override in another bounded observation. Results are not retroactively applied to baseline.

project_observations.name: actual_default_gyp
project_observations.operation: Inside dependency install lifecycle record actual command -v node-gyp, npm_config_node_gyp path+existence/mode and node-gyp --version status/output. Also inspect actual selected app npm bundled gyp path/version separately for comparison. Do NOT create a fallback, rewrite virtual paths, compile C or call a missing path a transport issue.

project_observations.name: package_manager
project_observations.operation: A matching exact packageManager=pnpm@10.34.7 project must run offline. A different exact version (e.g.10.34.6) may only demonstrate actual upstream switch attempt/failure within15s because no second executable/cache download is in this plan; successful offline self-switch remains unproved unless root separately approves a genuine exact second input. No disabling PM management, rewriting requests or faking cache entries.

ownership_cleanup: Before pull, record preexisting canonical node@childDigest/indexDigest references/configID and any containers referencing those IDs. Pull exact child only after fit; then label/use one unique own alias. Record every newly introduced reference explicitly.

Create/start only own labeled container; final cleanup uses exactID+labels+nonce+frozen configID. Stop/remove only that owned container. Interrupted create is reconciled by exact label/name/config before deletion; an ambiguous identity is reported, not guessed.

Remove own alias without force. Remove a newly introduced canonical digest reference only if it was absent before and fresh reference/container inventory confirms no foreign use. Never remove by broad image/configID, never force, never image/system/builder prune.

Docker retains shared blobs while any foreign reference/container uses them. If foreign use appears, preserve those references/layers, record retention and stop before case2 if budget is not demonstrably available.

Retain all verified inputs, raw command results, expected and unexpected failures, source hashes, metadata/budget timeline and cleanup proof. No cleanup of prior freezes, host caches, images or unrelated resources.
honesty: Observational completion is separate from viability. Missing default gyp or wrong NODE is a failed criterion, not an experiment pass. Preserve exact exit/status.
No native C compilation, repaired addon proof, common Bookworm donor/library proof, both-architecture coverage, original13/28 fixture proof, native-init/K8/hosted or Render live behavior claim.
No production/catalog/pin/source writes, builds, CI dispatch/cancel/rerun or implementation launcher/shim in this plan. No image layer/executable body downloads or Docker calls occurred preparing it.
